zetaris_audit.sql_query:
/* porchlight_88b5ca1ef51c483c9d49c3e7215df74e */
SELECT k.fips,k.name,k.state,k.geometry_valid,k.capture_id,n.cms_count,n.geocode_count,n.loaded_at
FROM porchlight_postgis.pl_nat_county_catalog_v3 k JOIN porchlight_postgis.pl_nat_capture_v1 n ON k.capture_id=n.capture_id
WHERE n.capture_id=(SELECT capture_id FROM porchlight_postgis.pl_nat_capture_v1 ORDER BY loaded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY k.state,k.name
